evaluation_surface.unlock_condition: all run-contract training seals and the complete 27-checkpoint tree validate; then perform one authorized panel unlock

prediction_alignment.report_order: canonical candidate order from the sealed panel manifest
prediction_alignment.map_tie_break: max by probability, then lexicographically greatest candidate_semantic_id, matching the frozen v0.8I analyzer
prediction_alignment.probabilities: four-way softmax output; no calibration, temperature fitting, or renormalization beyond the model softmax

metric_implementation_reference.scope: frozen reference for direct contrast definitions and semantic candidate alignment; this contract governs v0.8N-specific aggregation and does not authorize reuse of v0.8I data or predictions

locality_per_neighborhood.posterior_l1: sum_c abs(P(c|anchor)-P(c|perturbation)) over aligned candidate_semantic_id values

fact_sensitivity_per_neighborhood.new_candidate_rank_gain: rank_anchor(new)-rank_fact(new), descending probability with candidate_semantic_id tie-break

primary.comparison: B-SHAM-trained versus B-MATCHED-trained on heldout sham locality
primary.locality_effect_sign: positive favors B-SHAM; reported benefit is mean(B-MATCHED metric)-mean(B-SHAM metric) because lower locality is better
primary.unit: heldout neighborhood, paired across training arms within seed

secondary.generic_local_support: B-DUP versus B-MATCHED on heldout sham and matched-neutral locality
secondary.cross_perturbation_interaction: (R[B-SHAM,S]-R[B-MATCHED,S])-(R[B-SHAM,M]-R[B-MATCHED,M]); lower locality is better; negative indicates a larger SHAM-training advantage on the sham test axis
secondary.response_matrix: all three training arms by heldout fact_flip, matched_neutral, and sham views
secondary.anchor_preservation: all training arms on anchor targets
secondary.family_results: all metrics separately for the four sealed heldout families
effect_modifiers: raw unnormalized head-input-space distances: anchor-to-sham, anchor-to-matched, fact-to-sham, and fact-to-matched
surface/edit diagnostics: changed field identity, one-based line/token position, character span, whitespace-token count, family, and selected neutral-axis composition
secondary.effect_modifier_constraints: diagnostic only; no candidate replacement, reweighting, threshold changes, or selection based on these quantities
secondary.head_input_space: raw float32 frozen state features actually supplied to CompatibilityHead; no pre-existing normalization, centering, scaling, or covariance transform is applied

absolute_sensitivity_floor.aggregation: overall rate across all 2000 heldout neighborhoods for each arm and seed
absolute_sensitivity_floor.rule: both arms must meet or exceed the floor in every seed before locality differences can support a localized-control claim; otherwise locality is descriptive and the experiment is classified as sensitivity-insufficient
absolute_sensitivity_floor.historical_basis: lowest terminal K-DUP strict-transition rate across its three seeds

sensitivity_guard_and_claim_rules.localized_radius_control_support: absolute_sensitivity_floor passes for B-MATCHED and B-SHAM; both co-primary locality metrics favor B-SHAM in all three paired seeds; and mean strict transition B-SHAM minus B-MATCHED is at least -0.05

near_equivalence_margins.derivation: 10 percent of the v0.8K reported SHAM-DUP effects: 0.2383 L1 and 0.4513 MAP-flip rate
near_equivalence_margins.equivalence_rule: describe as approximately equivalent only if each metric's 90 percent paired neighborhood-bootstrap interval is fully within its margin for all three seeds; otherwise do not claim equivalence

sensitivity_guard_and_claim_rules.suppression_rule: locality improvement with either arm below the absolute sensitivity floor or mean strict fact-transition loss exceeding 0.05 is suppression/coupling or sensitivity-insufficient, not successful localized control
sensitivity_guard_and_claim_rules.seed_heterogeneity_rule: if either co-primary effect changes sign across seeds, report heterogeneous response and make no universal treatment claim
sensitivity_guard_and_claim_rules.radius_only_interpretation_ceiling: SHAM-MATCHED identifies an effect not reproduced by this prospectively radius-matched neutral_4/neutral_5 basis; it does not isolate semantic identity from representation direction, higher-order geometry, or the deliberately different edited field/position
sensitivity_guard_and_claim_rules.matched_basis_scope: the selected controls are prospectively radius-matched invariant perturbations from neutral_4 and neutral_5 only; they do not represent arbitrary irrelevant semantic changes
sensitivity_guard_and_claim_rules.duplicate_control_scope: B-DUP matches auxiliary event count and target weighting but repeats the anchor feature, therefore it controls supervision dose without matching novel support or gradient-correlation structure
sensitivity_guard_and_claim_rules.training_effect_claim: claims concern which auxiliary examples train the frozen-substrate decision head; they are not claims that the frozen backbone capability changed

uncertainty_and_multiplicity.sampling_unit: neighborhood; keep anchor, fact, sham, and matched descendants together

bootstrap.stratification: resample 500 neighborhoods with replacement within each of the four families
bootstrap.intervals: percentile 95 percent for effects; percentile 90 percent for declared equivalence checks

uncertainty_and_multiplicity.seed_reporting: show all three paired seed effects, mean, and median; bootstrap intervals are conditional on a trained seed and do not treat neighborhoods as independent optimizer replicates
uncertainty_and_multiplicity.pooled_seed_inference: no population-level p-value or confidence interval from only three optimizer seeds
uncertainty_and_multiplicity.multiplicity: the primary claim is an intersection requiring both co-primary metrics; family and interaction results are descriptive with intervals and no confirmatory p-values

interpretation_table.MATCHED_approximately_SHAM_and_both_lowe: consistent with useful local invariant support at the matched radius; not proof that radius is the mechanism
interpretation_table.SHAM_better_than_MATCHED_with_sensitivit: sham effect survives radius control for this selected neutral basis; radius alone is insufficient for this control basis
interpretation_table.SHAM_better_than_MATCHED_better_than_DUP: consistent with a generic local-support component plus a residual sham-training effect
interpretation_table.MATCHED_at_least_as_good_as_SHAM: the certified sham is not uniquely favored over this radius-matched control
interpretation_table.signs_disagree_by_seed: heterogeneous treatment response; no universal mechanism claim

reporting.checkpoint_epochs_1_and_2: sealed for integrity; not evaluated and not used for selection
